Human-Animal Chimera Prohibition Act of 2025
To amend title 18, United States Code, to prohibit certain types of human-animal chimeras.

action.text: Referred to the House Committee on the Judiciary.

bill.summary:
Human-Animal Chimera Prohibition Act of 2025
This bill establishes new federal crimes related to conduct involving certain types of human-animal chimeras. The term human-animal chimera means an organism that, from an early stage of development, contains human and nonhuman parts.
This bill makes it unlawful to
create or attempt to create a prohibited human-animal chimera,transfer or attempt to transfer a human embryo into a nonhuman womb,transfer or attempt to transfer a nonhuman embryo into a human womb, ortransport or receive for any purpose a prohibited human-animal chimera.A violator is subject to civil and criminal penalties.
